ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Child Care Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the financial records of child care programs in Minnesota to identify any suspicious transactions or patterns of abuse.
questions: What are the sources of funding for child care programs in Minnesota?
How are these funds being managed and allocated?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial records of child care programs, we may be able to identify patterns of abuse or suspicious transactions that could indicate fraud. This could help to shed light on the allegations made by Trump and provide a more nuanced understanding of the issue.
